tests.name: APK facts
tests.assertion: aapt2: package com.kissansahyog.app, label "Kisan Sahyog", minSdk 24, targetSdk 36, versionName 0.1.0, debuggable, permissions exactly the decided set
tests.notes: permissions: ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, INTERNET, MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS, RECORD_AUDIO, com.kissansahyog.app.DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED_PERMISSION

tests.name: Install + cold start
tests.assertion: After install and am start -W: process alive at 10 s, no FATAL EXCEPTION, page is https://localhost/, text contains "किसान", screenshot is not blank
tests.notes: am start -W: Status: ok, WaitTime 8002 ms (the emulator renders on a software GPU); title "किसान सहयोग — मंडी भाव, मौसम, योजनाएं व बाज़ार"
